prior_art_boundary.existing_scope: early M1 scalar/vector GEMV with a four-byte weight load and per-code branchless FP32 decode using integer-to-float conversion and scaling
prior_art_boundary.current_scope: M32 dual-resident-A WMMA with packed four-code construction of exact BF16 bits before staging shared B

candidate.scope: test-only exact [10240,5120] launcher and resource query; unreachable from production dispatch
candidate.baseline: production K64/LD72/N128 dual-resident-A M32 WMMA kernel

mechanism.removed: 256-entry shared U16 E4M3FN-to-BF16 codebook, its initialization store, publication barrier, and 32 indexed LDS.U16 instructions
mechanism.normal: form packed low BF16 bytes from mantissa nibbles and packed high bytes with a mandatory per-byte-safe integer ADD of the 0x3c bias
mechanism.subnormal: PRMT selects the exact low/high BF16 bytes for magnitudes 0..7
mechanism.nan: patch magnitude 0x7f to signed canonical quiet BF16 NaN
mechanism.final_interleave: PRMT selectors 0x5140 and 0x7362 form two BF16x2 words

decoded_b_store_audit.reason: decoded B was already emitted as four STS.128 instructions

compile_time_exactness.language: C++17 constexpr static_assert in the CUDA translation unit
compile_time_exactness.independent_reference: construct the same exact FP32 bits as decode_e4m3fn, then apply encode_bf16_rne bit rounding
compile_time_exactness.mixed_lane_definition: each of 256 codes is placed in each of four byte positions while the other positions rotate through 0x00, 0x01, 0x7f, and 0xff
semantic_cases: all seven subnormal magnitudes for both signs

sass.interpretation: the candidate removes the intended 512 bytes, 32 lookup loads, one store, and one barrier, but exact per-byte exceptional-case construction nearly doubles the static K64 body and exceeds both instruction stop limits

decision.reason: both exact packed constructors exceed the 680-instruction absolute stop and 240-instruction K64-body stop despite meeting every resource and shared-lookup-removal target
decision.reopen_when: only a native or materially cheaper exact four-byte lane constructor can plausibly keep the complete function at or below 648 instructions and the K64 body at or below 240
